name: @office/intelligence-memory
description: Office enterprise memory and benchmarking (OFF-015): the historical-learning module — deterministic OutcomeRecords derived from recorded events plus the margin engine's ImpactAssessment values, PURE benchmark facts computed from queried outcome sets (run-twice determinism; every value carries the producing outcome ids), reusable Lessons (typed links, applicability tags, provenance), typed project-similarity contracts with EXPOSED score composition (deterministic typed feature vectors — NO embeddings, NO opaque models), and the rebuildable memory-store projection (A2/A7: memory is a PROJECTION derived from its input events + assessments, never canonical truth). Depends only on @office/intelligence-margin (ImpactAssessment values + the commercial facts fold as outcome inputs), @office/intelligence-relationships (traversal subgraphs as similarity inputs), @office/contracts (envelopes, EntityRefs, parse helpers), @office/domain-kernel (Result/DomainError), @office/authz (deny-by-default permissioned memory reads), and @office/events (the ledger READ surface + LedgerEventId identity; this package never writes the ledger — memory events are emitted through the mirrored MemoryEventSink port). No AI/LLM/embedding/network dependency of ANY kind: similarity is deterministic typed computation over typed feature vectors.
